title: Deeper/broader peer defect triage and ACIS retained-output census closure
scope: Primary-source review of open-source DWG/DXF peer reports and a local static source census; advisory evidence only.

sources.observation: AC1032 INSERT count changes reported on private files; later discussion identifies a possible TABLE-as-INSERT count confound but does not establish the earlier report's root cause.
Separate TableEntity DXF writer support request; do not transfer its later-version behavior to the #1172 reader report.
Peer-reported DWG writer crash for anonymous-flagged short block names; no local defect or normative rule inferred.
LEADER zero text dimensions; already covered by existing plan owner and not duplicated.
Class maturity/disposition is implementation-specific and does not establish libdxfrw semantics.
ACIS support is bounded and is not a general geometry kernel.
DWG path invokes an external converter followed by DXF import; those stages remain separately qualified.

local_audit.result: All input-proportional retained parser, graph, projection, cache, diagnostic, and worklist insertions inspected were covered by existing logical budgets before insertion/reservation. DRW_AcisModel::nodesOfType remains an unbounded caller-sized API query with no in-tree bounded-pipeline callers.

decisions: Do not add a finding from peer-only reports without a local reproducer or authoritative contract.
Reconcile INSERT/TABLE counts by concrete type, handle, and owner rather than broad inheritance counts.
Keep short anonymous block-name coverage conditional on the applicable local version/profile contract.
Close the 7S.3 retained-output source census; continue independent 7S.2c owners without external gates.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
